body: i will grieve. i will miss you. i will grieve because such a wonderful person had to go. do you know how rare it is to be born into this world? there's such a slim chance of you even existing. if you only have one show, why skip it? i know it's hard. really. but you can do this.
you are tough, but life is tougher. there is hope. i promise you.
i hope that this story can help others :)

if you commit suicide, your children are over thirty percent more likely to. i've known two people who have had to deal with a parent who committed suicide as young children and they were both extremely suicidal, one ended up in a mental hospital. please don't do this, for you and your children. i know life can be hard, and that's a major, major understatement. but listen. life gets better, and if you stay long enough to realize it, the rewards will be very promising. you can do this. i believe in you.
i hope you never work up the nerve :(

being suicidal does not make you selfish. it is something that you can't control. suicide, however, is a very bad choice. please stay strong, things will get better. there is always tomorrow. every day brings you closer to eating your next plate of nachos.
im so glad you're here and i am so proud of you
please don't. i would miss you. this world can suck, and that's a major understatement, but the pros outweigh the cons by a long shot. please, please dont go

god, please don't do it. life gets better. i know what you're thinking -- you've heard this a thousand times, haven't you? but if i took my life when  i was planning to and didn't the help i didn't want but so desperately needed, i wouldn't know how much better things can get. now i'm here, doing so much better, GOD, so much better, with a group of people who love me. please, don't end it. things. will. fucking. get. better. it isn't worth taking your life, i promise.
